name: Kodera Wataru
source: Honest and hard working salary man. He climbed up to the top at the company thanks to his earnest and steady efforts after many years. However, all of that were destroyed after he got fired due to false accusation of train molester from both of his colleagues. He had to leave the company in disgrace because no one believed him, to say nothing of the woman Akane and the man Hayato who are the main culprits. With nothing left to lose, he vows to take revenge on those who ruined his life.
